segments.snp3.12:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
segments.snp3.12:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadahuposathe pannarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.
segments.snp3.12:1.4: Atha kho bhagavā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.snp3.12:2.1: “‘Ye te, bhikkhave, kusalā dhammā ariyā niyyānikā sambodhagāmino, tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ariyānaṃ niyyānikānaṃ sambodhagāmīnaṃ kā upanisā savanāyā’ti iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu, te evamassu vacanīyā –
segments.snp3.12:3.2: Ayaṃ dukkhanirodho, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:3.3: Evaṃ sammā dvayatānupassino kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ – diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā”ti.
segments.snp3.12:4.2: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:5.3: Yattha ca sabbaso dukkhaṃ, asesaṃ uparujjhati;
segments.snp3.12:6.3: Abhabbā te antakiriyāya, te ve jātijarūpagā.
segments.snp3.12:7.1: “Ye ca dukkhaṃ pajānanti, atho dukkhassa sambhavaṃ;
segments.snp3.12:7.3: Yattha ca sabbaso dukkhaṃ, asesaṃ uparujjhati;
segments.snp3.12:8.3: Bhabbā te antakiriyāya, na te jātijarūpagā”ti.
segments.snp3.12:9.1: (2)“‘Siyā aññenapi pariyāyena sammā dvayatānupassanā’ti, iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu;
segments.snp3.12:9.4: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ upadhipaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:9.5: Upadhīnaṃ tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:9.6: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:10.3: Yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkhamupeti mando;
segments.snp3.12:10.5: Tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, dukkhassa jātippabhavānupassī”ti.
segments.snp3.12:11.1: (3)“‘Siyā aññenapi pariyāyena sammā dvayatānupassanā’ti, iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu;
segments.snp3.12:11.4: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ avijjāpaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:11.5: Avijjāya tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:11.6: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:13.3: Vijjāgatā ca ye sattā, na te gacchanti [nāgacchanti (sī. pī.)] punabbhavan”ti.
segments.snp3.12:14.3: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ saṅkhārapaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:14.4: Saṅkhārānaṃ tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:14.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:16.5: Evaṃ dukkhakkhayo hoti, etaṃ ñatvā yathātathaṃ.
segments.snp3.12:17.3: Abhibhuyya mārasaṃyogaṃ, na gacchanti [nāgacchanti (sī. pī.)] punabbhavan”ti.
segments.snp3.12:18.3: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ viññāṇapaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:18.4: Viññāṇassa tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:18.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:21.3: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ phassapaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:21.4: Phassassa tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:21.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:23.1: “Ye ca phassaṃ pariññāya, aññāyupasame [paññāya upasame (syā.)] ratā;
segments.snp3.12:24.3: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ vedanāpaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:24.4: Vedanānaṃ tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:24.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:25.1: “Sukhaṃ vā yadi vā dukkhaṃ, adukkhamasukhaṃ saha;
segments.snp3.12:25.3: Ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca, yaṃ kiñci atthi veditaṃ.
segments.snp3.12:26.3: Phussa phussa vayaṃ passaṃ, evaṃ tattha vijānati [virajjati (ka. sī.)];
segments.snp3.12:27.3: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ taṇhāpaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:27.4: Taṇhāya tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:27.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:29.1: “Etamādīnavaṃ ñatvā, taṇhaṃ [taṇhā (bahūsu) itivuttake 15 passitabbaṃ] dukkhassa sambhavaṃ;
segments.snp3.12:30.3: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ upādānapaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:30.4: Upādānānaṃ [upādānassa (syā. ka.)] tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:30.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:31.3: Jātassa maraṇaṃ hoti, eso dukkhassa sambhavo.
segments.snp3.12:33.3: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ ārambhapaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:33.4: Ārambhānaṃ tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:33.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:37.3: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ āhārapaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:37.4: Āhārānaṃ tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:37.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:40.3: Saṅkhāya sevī dhammaṭṭho, saṅkhyaṃ [saṅkhaṃ (sī. pī.)] nopeti vedagū”ti.
segments.snp3.12:41.3: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ iñjitapaccayāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:41.4: Iñjitānaṃ tveva asesavirāganirodhā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:41.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:43.3: Tasmā hi ejaṃ vossajja, saṅkhāre uparundhiya;
segments.snp3.12:44.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:47.3: Rūpehi, bhikkhave, arūpā [āruppā (sī. pī.)] santatarāti, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:47.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:48.1: “Ye ca rūpūpagā sattā, ye ca arūpaṭṭhāyino [āruppavāsino (sī. pī.)];
segments.snp3.12:49.1: “Ye ca rūpe pariññāya, arūpesu asaṇṭhitā [susaṇṭhitā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.snp3.12:49.3: Nirodhe ye vimuccanti, te janā maccuhāyino”ti.
segments.snp3.12:50.3: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya idaṃ saccanti upanijjhāyitaṃ tadamariyānaṃ etaṃ musāti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:50.4: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa … pe … sadevamanussāya idaṃ musāti upanijjhāyitaṃ, tadamariyānaṃ etaṃ saccanti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:50.5: Evaṃ sammā … pe … athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:51.1: “Anattani attamāniṃ [attamānī (syā.), attamānaṃ (pī. ka.)], passa lokaṃ sadevakaṃ;
segments.snp3.12:52.1: “Yena yena hi maññanti, tato taṃ hoti aññathā;
segments.snp3.12:52.3: Tañhi tassa musā hoti, mosadhammañhi ittaraṃ.
segments.snp3.12:54.1: (16)“‘Siyā aññenapi pariyāyena sammā dvayatānupassanā’ti, iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu;
segments.snp3.12:54.4: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya idaṃ sukhanti upanijjhāyitaṃ, tadamariyānaṃ etaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ, ayamekānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:54.5: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa … pe … sadevamanussāya idaṃ dukkhanti upanijjhāyitaṃ tadamariyānaṃ etaṃ sukhanti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ, ayaṃ dutiyānupassanā.
segments.snp3.12:54.6: Evaṃ sammā dvayatānupassino kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ – diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitāti.
segments.snp3.12:54.9: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.12:55.1: “Rūpā saddā rasā gandhā, phassā dhammā ca kevalā;
segments.snp3.12:55.3: Iṭṭhā kantā manāpā ca, yāvatatthīti vuccati.
segments.snp3.12:56.3: Yattha cete nirujjhanti, taṃ nesaṃ dukkhasammataṃ.
segments.snp3.12:58.1: “Yaṃ pare sukhato āhu, tadariyā āhu dukkhato;
segments.snp3.12:58.3: Yaṃ pare dukkhato āhu, tadariyā sukhato vidū.
segments.snp3.12:59.1: “Passa dhammaṃ durājānaṃ, sampamūḷhetthaviddasu [sampamūḷhettha aviddasu (sī. pī.), sammūḷhettha aviddasu (?)];
segments.snp3.12:60.3: Santike na vijānanti, maggā dhammassa kovidā.
segments.snp3.12:63.2: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
segments.snp3.12:63.3: Imasmiṃ ca [imasmiṃ kho (sī.)] pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti.
segments.snp3.12:64.1: Saccaṃ upadhi avijjā ca, saṅkhāre viññāṇapañcamaṃ;
segments.snp3.12:64.5: Iñjitaṃ calitaṃ rūpaṃ, saccaṃ dukkhena soḷasāti.
segments.snp3.12:65.3: Māghasuttaṃ sabhiyo ca, selo sallañca vuccati.

lines: Jātimaraṇasaṃsāranti khandhanibbattiṃ jātiṃ khandhabhedaṃ maraṇaṃ khandhapaṭipāṭiṃ saṃsārañca.
Vijjāgatā ca ye sattāti ye ca arahattamaggavijjāya kilese vijjhitvā gatā khīṇāsavasattā.
738-9. Etamādīnavaṃ ñatvāti yadidaṃ dukkhaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā, etaṃ ādīnavanti ñatvā.
Sabbasaṅkhārasamathāti sabbesaṃ vuttappakārānaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ maggañāṇena samathā, upahatatāya phalasamatthatāyāti vuttaṃ hoti.
Etaṃ ñatvā yathātathanti etaṃ dukkhakkhayaṃ aviparītaṃ ñatvā.
Evaṃ ettha padapaṭipāṭiyā vattabbāni nāmarūpasaḷāyatanāni avatvā phasso vutto.
Tāni hi rūpamissakattā kammasampayuttāneva na honti, idañca vaṭṭadukkhaṃ kammato vā sambhaveyya kammasampayuttadhammato vāti.
Etaṃ dukkhanti ñatvānāti etaṃ sabbaṃ vedayitaṃ “dukkhakāraṇan”ti ñatvā, vipariṇāmaṭṭhitiaññāṇadukkhatāhi vā dukkhaṃ ñatvā.
Evaṃ tattha vijānatīti evaṃ tā vedanā vijānāti, tattha vā dukkhabhāvaṃ vijānāti.
Vedanānaṃ khayāti tato paraṃ maggañāṇena kammasampayuttānaṃ vedanānaṃ khayā.
Etamādīnavaṃ ñatvā, taṇhaṃ dukkhassa sambhavanti etaṃ dukkhassa sambhavaṃ taṇhāya ādīnavaṃ ñatvā.
Jātassa maraṇanti yatrāpi “bhūto sukhaṃ nigacchatī”ti bālā maññanti, tatrāpi dukkhameva dassento āha –
Dutiyagāthāya yojanā – aniccādīhi sammadaññāya paṇḍitā upādānakkhayā jātikkhayaṃ nibbānaṃ abhiññāya na gacchanti punabbhavanti.
Aparo nayo – catubbidhā sattā rūpūpagā, vedanūpagā, saññūpagā, saṅkhārūpagāti.
Evampi yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti, sabbaṃ āhārapaccayāti veditabbaṃ.
Saṅkhāya sevīti cattāro paccaye paccavekkhitvā sevamāno,“pañcakkhandhā dvādasāyatanāni aṭṭhārasadhātuyo”ti evaṃ vā lokaṃ saṅkhāya “aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ anattā”ti ñāṇena sevamāno.
Saṅkhyaṃ nopetīti “devo”ti vā “manusso”ti vā ādikaṃ saṅkhyaṃ na gacchati.
Saṅkhāre uparundhiyāti kammaṃ kammasampayutte ca saṅkhāre nirodhetvā.
(13) Terasamavāre nissitassa calitanti taṇhāya taṇhādiṭṭhimānehi vā khandhe nissitassa sīhasutte (saṃ. ni.3.78) devānaṃ viya bhayacalanaṃ hoti.
Maccuhāyinoti maraṇamaccu kilesamaccu devaputtamaccuhāyino, tividhampi taṃ maccuṃ hitvā gāminoti vuttaṃ hoti.
Tañhi lokena dhuvasubhasukhattavasena “idaṃ saccan”ti upanijjhāyitaṃ diṭṭhamālokitaṃ.
Etaṃ musāti etaṃ dhuvādivasena gahitampi musā, na tādisaṃ hotīti.
Tañhi lokena rūpavedanādīnamabhāvato “idaṃ musā natthi kiñcī”ti upanijjhāyitaṃ.

Tadamariyānaṃ etaṃ saccanti taṃ idaṃ ariyānaṃ etaṃ nikkilesasaṅkhātā subhabhāvā, pavattidukkhapaṭipakkhasaṅkhātā sukhabhāvā, accantasantisaṅkhātā niccabhāvā ca anapagamanena paramatthato “saccan”ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ.
Idaṃ saccanti maññatīti idaṃ nāmarūpaṃ dhuvādivasena “saccan”ti maññati.
Yena yena hīti yena yena rūpe vā vedanāya vā “mama rūpaṃ, mama vedanā”tiādinā nayena maññanti.
Tato tanti tato maññitākārā taṃ nāmarūpaṃ hoti aññathā.
Tañhi tassa musā hoti, yasmā taṃ yathāmaññitākārā musā hoti, tasmā aññathā hotīti attho.
Mosadhammañhi ittaraṃ, yasmā yaṃ ittaraṃ parittapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ, taṃ mosadhammaṃ nassanadhammaṃ hoti, tathārūpañca nāmarūpanti.
Tañhi lokena salabhamacchamakkaṭādīhi padīpabaḷisalepādayo viya “idaṃ sukhan”ti upanijjhāyitaṃ.

Tadamariyānaṃ etaṃ dukkhanti taṃ idaṃ ariyānaṃ “kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā, virūparūpena mathenti cittan”tiādinā (su. ni.50; cūḷani. khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa 136) nayena “etaṃ dukkhan”ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ.
Tadamariyānanti taṃ idaṃ ariyānaṃ paramatthasukhato “etaṃ sukhan”ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ.
Yāvatatthīti vuccatīti yāvatā ete cha ārammaṇā atthīti vuccanti.
767-8. Sukhanti diṭṭhamariyehi, sakkāyassuparodhananti “sukha” miti ariyehi pañcakkhandhanirodho diṭṭho, nibbānanti vuttaṃ hoti.
Nivutānaṃ tamo hoti, andhakāro apassataṃ, bālānaṃ avijjāya nivutānaṃ otthaṭānaṃ andhabhāvakaraṇo tamo hoti, yena nibbānadhammaṃ daṭṭhuṃ na sakkonti.
Satañca vivaṭaṃ hoti, āloko passatāmivāti satañca sappurisānaṃ paññādassanena passataṃ ālokova vivaṭaṃ hoti nibbānaṃ.

Santike na vijānanti, magā dhammassakovidāti yaṃ attano sarīre tacapañcakamattaṃ paricchinditvā anantarameva adhigantabbato, attano khandhānaṃ vā nirodhamattato santike nibbānaṃ, taṃ evaṃ santike santampi na vijānanti magabhūtā janā maggāmaggadhammassa saccadhammassa vā akovidā, sabbathā bhavarāga … pe … susambudho.
